# Jobs (professions)

## In short
When you join a town you pick a job on the welcome screen. The welcome screen won't let you stay "Undecided". It also hides any job switched off in the town's `disabled_jobs` setting, and the Shaman job is switched off by default [1] [2]. Hero jobs bring a job item and extra home defense, and their hero skills are applied at the start [3] [4]. A quick guide:
- **Digging:** Scavenger.
- **Moving through zombies:** Scout.
- **Fighting in the desert and town defense:** Guardian.
- **Building:** Technician.
- **Camping and staying fed far away:** Survivalist.
- **Sending loot home:** Tamer.

## How it works

**Choosing a job**
- The welcome screen always shows the job step. The alias step and the skill step only appear the first time you join, and only if the town allows them (`OptFeatureCitizenAlias`, `SkillMode`) [1].
- The server refuses (400) a job that doesn't exist, is the default `none`, or is in `TownSetting::DisabledJobs` [1].
- If your citizen was already set up once, choosing a job only re-applies it and skips the rest [1].
- What happens when a job is applied (`applyProfession`) [5]:
  - The old job's items, including its alternative items, are removed from your inventory.
  - Each item of the new job that you don't already have is created as an *essential* item.
  - Technicians get full CP (6) and everyone else gets 0. Scouts get full SP and everyone else gets 0. MP is set to 0 for everyone.
  - Moving from a non-hero job to a hero job removes your "proxy" special actions.
- What happens when you join with a **hero job** [3]:
  - You get an essential camera (`photo_3_#00`) if your account has the `f_cam` unlock.
  - Your hero skills are applied: citizen properties, extra chest space, start items and heroic actions. With `SkillMode` on, these are the skills you picked: at most one per group, and their total level can't exceed your pack points plus grace points [1]. With `SkillMode` off, you get all your unlocked legacy powers [1].
- Heroic actions only work for citizens whose job is heroic [6].

**Every job** [card:profession:*:en via list_entities profession]

| Job (`id`) | Hero | Starting items | Alternative items | Dig bonus |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Undecided (`none`) | no | Town Uniform | Dirty Uniform | 0 |
| Resident (`basic`) | no | Town Uniform | Dirty Uniform | 0 |
| Scavenger (`collec`) | yes | Town Uniform, Small Spade | Dirty Uniform | +20% |
| Guardian (`guardian`) | yes | Town Uniform, Riot Shield | Dirty Uniform, Riot Shield (strapped) | 0 |
| Scout (`hunter`) | yes | Town Uniform, Camouflage Vest | Dirty Uniform, Camouflage Vest (not equipped!) | 0 |
| Shaman (`shaman`) | yes | Town Uniform, Voodoo Mask | Dirty Uniform | 0 |
| Survivalist (`survivalist`) | yes | Town Uniform, Survival Book | Dirty Uniform | 0 |
| Tamer (`tamer`) | yes | Town Uniform, Three-legged Labradoodle | Dirty Uniform, Well fed / Tired / No labradoodle | 0 |
| Technician (`tech`) | yes | Town Uniform, Handyman's Toolbelt | Dirty Uniform | 0 |

**Bonus shared by all hero jobs:** +2 home defense, plus the `defense` and `fence` home upgrades described under "What changes it" [4].

**Scavenger (`collec`)**
- **Dig bonus 0.2.** It is added to the base dig chance, which is 0.6 by default [list_entities profession] [7]. It is also added to the chance when searching buildings and explorable ruins [8].
- **Faster digging:** one dig every 1 h 30 instead of every 2 h [9] [10].
- **Ruin exploration time:** the rules give scavengers `+7min30sec` against `+5min` for other jobs [9].
- **Sees how many digs a zone has left:** level 0 if ≤0, 1 if ≤2, 2 if ≤6, otherwise 3. Other jobs only see that a zone is depleted.
- **Neighbour zones:** when a scavenger loads a zone, the 4 adjacent occupied zones are updated too [10].
- **Trash search limit:** +1 [11].
- **Small Spade, "Excavate zone":**
  - Scavengers only, once per day.
  - The zone must be empty and must not have been force-regenerated already.
  - It regenerates the zone and stops your dig timers [12] [13].

**Guardian (`guardian`)**
- **Home defense:** +1 on top of the hero +2 [4].
- **Town defense:** each living guardian who is in town adds +5 (`GuardianDefenseBonus`) [4].
- **Riot Shield** [5] [14] [15]:
  - While it is unbroken in your bag, it gives +2 control points (base is 2).
  - It is worth 15 night watch defense.
  - "Strap" turns it into the strapped version, which lets you carry another heavy item but gives no bonus.
- **No better watch survival:** an old 3% base death chance for guardians on watch is commented out. Guardians use the normal 8% base.

**Scout (`hunter`)**
- **Stealth points (SP):** max SP is 2, plus any `MaxSpExtension` bonus [5].
- **Move cost:** at 3 km or more from town, a move costs SP first and AP after that [11].
- **Camouflage Vest:**
  - Put it on in town, or outside if you have no followers and the zone is under control [16].
  - While worn, you can move out of zones controlled by zombies [17].
  - Each zombie lowers camping by only 3 instead of 7 [5].
- **Chance of being spotted** when you enter a zone where zombies outnumber the control points [17]:
  1. `delta = floor((zombies − CP) × 1.3)`, minus 5 at night.
  2. If `delta` is 6 or less, it is halved.
  3. Chance = `max(0, delta − 3 × zone scout level)%`.
- **Scout level display:** scouts see the zone's scout level.

**Technician (`tech`)**
- **Construction points (CP):** max CP is 6 [5]. When building, AP is spent first and CP after that [18].
- **Toolbelt "Repair (3CP)":** repairs an item for 3 CP. You can't use it while tired or with wounded hands [19].
- **Techniker-Werkstatt (`small_techtable_#00`):** usable once per day, cost 3 for technicians and 5 for everyone else.

**Survivalist (`survivalist`)**
- **Camping cap:** the camping chance can reach 100% (cap 1.0). For other jobs the cap is `CitizenProperties::CampingChanceCap` [5].
- **Survival Book, "Water" or "Food":**
  - Only more than 3 km from town, once per day (status `tg_sbook`). "Food" also needs you to be below full AP [20].
  - Success chance by town day [21]:

    | Town day | Success chance |
    |---|---|
    | before day 5 | 100% |
    | day 5 | 85% |
    | day 10 | 80% |
    | day 13 | 70% |
    | day 15 | 60% |
    | day 20 | 50% |

  - In a devastated town the chance drops by 20 points, with a minimum of 10%.
  - **Water success:** walking distance is reset. A ghoul gets a wound instead. Otherwise `thirst2` becomes `thirst1`, or `thirst1` is removed and you get `hasdrunk` plus AP.
  - **Food success:** you get `haseaten` plus AP.
  - **AP gained:** AP goes up to 6, and SP goes up to your bonus SP if you have any.

**Tamer (`tamer`)**
- **Labradoodle, sending items home** [22] [21]:
  - "Send to the Bank" or "Send to the Chest" sends everything in your rucksack except essential items.
  - It fails if the gate is closed, if you carry a heavy item (unless the dog is "Well fed", fed with Steak), or if there is too little room at the destination.
  - Afterwards the dog becomes Tired.
- **Other dog actions:** fetch an item from your chest or from the bank, protect you, stand guard, guard the house, bury you (a grave camp, +8 camping) [22] [5].
- **Explorable ruins:** tamers are shown the exit or stairs.

**Shaman (`shaman`)**
- Gets the shaman workshop recipes ("Schamanenkreis").
- May carry more than one soul [23].
- Note that mystic points (5) come from the *shaman role*, not from the job [5].

## What changes it
- **Hero skills** add citizen properties [24] [25]:
  - Prepared: +1 control point each for base, clean, hydrated and sober.
  - Strategist: +10 watch defense; at level 3 also +2% watch survival.
- **Hero home upgrades:** the `defense` upgrade counts +1 per level up to level 6, then +2 per level after that. The `fence` upgrade gives +3 [4].
- **Guide role:** adds +1 control point per citizen in the zone, and lets a scout add the town-wide scout level [5].
- **`terror` status:** sets your control points to 0 [5].
- **Account unlocks:** `f_cam` gives hero jobs a camera; `f_arma` and `f_wtns` apply to any job [3].
- **Town setting `disabled_jobs`:** removes jobs from the welcome screen [2].

## Town types
- **Default:** Shaman job disabled [2].
- **Small:** additionally switches off the shaman role (`disabled_roles: ["shaman"]`) and shaman mode (`features.shaman: "none"`) [26].
- **Panda (Pandemonium):** ruin exploration time is `+5min15sec` for scavengers and `+3min30sec` for everyone else [27]. Both survivalist camping tables are smaller in panda, the first-camp bonus being +50 instead of +80 [5].
- **Remote and custom:** their rule differences change nothing about jobs [28] [29].

## Related
Digging, camping, scouts and camouflage, night watch, town defense, hero skills, roles (shaman, guide), heroic XP. You earn 2 HXP once per job for surviving 10 days as that job, except Shaman [30].

## Not verified
- **Who may pick a hero job:** I found no hero-status check in the welcome-screen code, so any limit must live elsewhere.
- **From summaries I didn't check in code:**
  - the dig, search and ruin chance formulas;
  - the scout spotting formula;
  - the nightly refill (SP +2, or +4 for scouts, with `tg_start_sp`);
  - the scavenger's +1 trash limit;
  - the "Excavate zone" effect;
  - the shaman's soul-carrying exception.
- **Default value of `CampingChanceCap`:** not found. A code comment says 90% for non-survivalists.
